card.title: One Mistake from Gone
card.instruction: Treat every decision as a test of whether you still deserve your place.

before.speaker: A
before.text: I've signed the delivery form. Was my signature managerial enough?

before.speaker: B
before.text: It just needs to be legible.

before.speaker: A
before.text: So they've lowered the standard for me?

before.speaker: A
before.text: Then I'll practise until I deserve the same form.

candidate.speaker: A
candidate.text: I've signed for the delivery. Does that look like someone who should still be warehouse manager?

candidate.speaker: B
candidate.text: I'm the driver. You signed in my box. Use the manager box.

candidate.speaker: A
candidate.text: Already doing someone else's job. Should I hand back my keys?

candidate.speaker: B
candidate.text: Only the wrapping's torn. Accept the pallet or send it back; I need to leave.

candidate.speaker: A
candidate.text: Accept damaged stock or waste a delivery? Which mistake lets me stay manager?

records.mechanism: A interprets a minor administrative choice and its correction as judgments about retaining a managerial place.
records.confusableConcept: Perfectionism: A3 proposes handing back managerial keys, and A5 reads a form correction as probation for the role.
records.distinguishingEvidence: Revised B2 names the manager box; A3 makes choosing another box a reason for removal, and A5 treats B4's repair as conditional retention.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 tests managerial adequacy and A5 questions deserving the same form, though entitlement to the position remains indirect.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 interprets B2's legibility standard as lowered expectations; A5 uses B4's same-form correction as a new standard to earn.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 correct A's assumptions but have no specific delivery need beyond these corrections.

heightening.evidence: A5 proposes practice, adding little immediate consequence to the already signed form.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies a delivery form and managerial signature concern but leaves B's role open.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's desire to 'deserve the same form' follows the repeated standard discussion without much padding.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 makes signing a delivery a test of remaining manager; A3 proposes surrendering keys over the wrong signature box; A5 measures both pallet decisions by whether A keeps the position.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's wrong-box correction becomes A3's fear of doing someone else's job. B4's accept-or-return choice directly supplies A5's dilemma, although the torn wrapping arrives abruptly.

relationship.evidence: B2 establishes a driver with limited responsibility; B4's 'I need to leave' gives B a practical want and forces A toward a decision.

heightening.evidence: B4 moves from a clerical error to responsibility for a pallet, but A5 repeats the keep-my-job question after A3 has already offered to surrender the keys.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a warehouse delivery and managerial insecurity; B2 supplies distinct signature boxes, and B4 supplies a playable pallet decision.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Already doing someone else's job' economically transforms B2's correction; A5's 'Which mistake' follows A's sincere assumption that either choice threatens belonging.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 says A signed in the driver's box; A3 interprets that specific error as occupational trespass warranting loss of managerial keys.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 demands acceptance or return of the pallet; A5 converts those exact options into competing threats to continued employment.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1, A3 and A5 consistently treat ordinary workplace judgments as tests of deserving the managerial position.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 applies the established insecurity to a consequential stock decision under B4's time pressure, but adds little commitment beyond A3's proposed resignation.

records.writerReservation: A1 and A5 still state the employment fear directly. A5 deliberately exaggerates torn wrapping into damaged stock; that anxious inference should remain sincere. The preserved confusableConcept and distinguishingEvidence contain earlier probation/repair wording; the current B4 instead offers a concrete acceptance choice.
records.reviewerReservation: Rejected: A5 mainly restates the insecurity after A3's stronger keys offer. The more consequential decision provides workable development but insufficient heightening for an internal pass. No rewrite performed in this bounded review.

card.title: I Was There
card.instruction: Treat your presence during a difficult time as an enduring claim on loyalty, honesty, and consideration.

before.speaker: A
before.text: I drove through that storm for you. Don't give me the polite refusal.

before.speaker: A
before.text: Then tell me what with. I earned a noun.

before.speaker: A
before.text: The road's repaired. My expectation of honesty hasn't.

candidate.speaker: A
candidate.text: I drove through that storm after your dad died. Help me move Saturday.

candidate.speaker: A
candidate.text: I missed my anniversary to sit with you. Swimming can wait.

candidate.speaker: B
candidate.text: I'll pay for movers. I can't miss another day with them.

candidate.speaker: A
candidate.text: Keep the money. Bring the kids after swimming. I was family that night; I expect all of you at my leaving tea.

records.mechanism: S80 treats having stayed present during another person's hardship as a lasting entitlement to honesty, loyalty, or consideration.
records.confusableConcept: Ordinary repayment asks for an equivalent favor; A instead claims an enduring right to a more candid relationship.
records.distinguishingEvidence: A1 invokes presence during bereavement; when B4 offers paid movers, A5 declines money and requests personal presence at the emotionally difficult empty-house moment.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 invokes driving through a storm as grounds for candor, and A5 insists the resulting claim has survived the years.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 asks for the content of B2's busyness; A5 answers B4's elapsed-time objection with the claim's continuing force.

relationship.evidence: B2 asserts a present scheduling boundary, and B4 challenges how long past help can justify A's demand.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes the claim explicitly enduring after B4 tries to date it out of relevance.

specificity.evidence: A1 supplies the storm journey and a refusal; A3 turns the vague 'busy' into a concrete request for what occupies B.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'I earned a noun' compresses the demand for specificity into A's claimed entitlement.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 invokes presence after the father's death to demand moving help; A3 adds the missed anniversary; A5 explicitly converts that night into enduring family status and an expectation of attendance.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 directly dismisses B2's swimming commitment. A5 rejects B4's payment offer and accommodates time with the children, but introduces a leaving tea as a new destination for the obligation.

relationship.evidence: B2 protects a family outing; B4 offers paid movers while explaining the cost of missing another day with the children. A5 responds with a compromise that still asserts a personal claim.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands the claim to 'all of you' after B4 protects family time, but attendance after swimming reduces the immediate burden, and the newly introduced tea weakens the sense of accumulating consequence.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes Saturday's move and the storm after a bereavement; B2 and B4 establish the children's outing. A5's leaving tea is playable but only appears at the final turn.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Swimming can wait' is economical. A5 explains the family claim explicitly and adds a farewell event, producing a clear character move but a less concentrated comic turn.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 identifies swimming with the children as the conflict. A3 answers that precise priority by invoking A's own sacrificed anniversary.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 offers money and insists on time with the children. A5 refuses money, moves the demand after swimming and includes the children, turning practical help into personal attendance.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1 and A3 establish past presence as a debt; A5's 'I was family that night' makes the continuing claim on consideration explicit.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 broadens the obligation from B's moving labor to the whole family's presence. This preserves the card-driven game, although the new tea and easier timing limit the heightening.

records.writerReservation: A5 states the entitlement plainly, and the leaving tea is introduced in that turn. The preserved confusable-concept field emphasizes candor, while this revision demonstrates the card's consideration and loyalty; the preserved distinguishing evidence's empty-house description is now contextual rather than explicit dialogue.
records.reviewerReservation: Reject the supplied candidate on this pass. The persistent weakness is A5's late substitution of a leaving tea for moving help: it preserves the entitlement but dilutes the consequence and requires new occasion-setting at the payoff. No rewrite or source change was performed.
